# Develop Physical AI Reasoning, World, and Action Models with NVIDIA Cosmos 3
## AI-Generated Summary
### Next Steps
[NVIDIA Cosmos 3](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai/cosmos/) is a frontier foundation model for physical AI that combines physical reasoning, world generation, and action generation within a single open model.

![A video clip generated by Cosmos 3 for the autonomous driving domain. The video is from a vehicle’s point-of-view at an intersection. Another car crosses the intersection in front of this vehicle, and then the vehicle takes a left turn. The video looks realistic and shows houses, trees, and cars in the surroundings.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Traffic-Light.gif)_Figure 1._

![A video shows a corridor with shelves of boxes on either side and a pile of boxes on the ground. Three people are standing next to the pile of boxes. There’s a small explosion from one of the boxes on the floor, and it starts smoking. ](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Fire.gif)_Figure 2._ _A video generated using Cosmos 3 for warehouse safety data._

## What’s new in Cosmos 3 [Scroll to What’s new in Cosmos 3 section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/develop-physical-ai-reasoning-world-and-action-models-with-nvidia-cosmos-3/#what%E2%80%99s_new_in_cosmos_3)
### Supported modalities [Scroll to Supported modalities section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/develop-physical-ai-reasoning-world-and-action-models-with-nvidia-cosmos-3/#supported_modalities)
|  |  |  |
|-|-|-|
| **Input** | **Output** | **Application** |
| Text | Image | Physically-plausible Image generation |
| Text | Video | Video | World model for rare edge case video data generation |
| Text | Image | Video | World model for prediction |
| Text | Image | Video | Text | VLM for reasoning |
| Video | Text | Video | Action | World action model, video action model, vision language action model, policy model for robot learning |

## NVIDIA Cosmos Human Evaluation benchmark [Scroll to NVIDIA Cosmos Human Evaluation benchmark section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/develop-physical-ai-reasoning-world-and-action-models-with-nvidia-cosmos-3/#nvidia_cosmos_human_evaluation_benchmark)
Each generated video is decomposed into single-fact yes/no questions across four dimensions—semantic alignment, physical laws, geometric reasoning, and visual integrity—spanning seven Physical AI domains, including robotics, autonomous vehicles, and physics.

# Welcome NVIDIA Cosmos 3: The First Open Omni-model for Physical AI Reasoning and Action
### SECTION 1: What's new with Cosmos 3?
Cosmos 3 enables all of this in a single model that can reason and generate different modalities in one unified forward pass.

This means you can now do all this from one model:

Not just pixels and tokens, but motion, causality, physics, and action.

Video generated by Cosmos 3 for robotics pick and place use-cases.

Video generated by Cosmos 3 for long tail driving scenarios.

Cosmos 3 chain-of-thought reasoning in an autonomous driving application.

### SECTION 2: Cosmos 3 Capabilities
| **Input Modality** | **Output Modality** | **Application** |
|-|-|-|
| Text | Image | Video | Video | Video Model |
| Text | Video | Text | Vision Language Model (VLM) |
| Text | Video | Action | Inverse Dynamics Model |

### Generate worlds with sight and sound.
Cosmos 3 creates physically aware video from text, images, or clips, and can pair motion with audio that follows visible events, source movement, and scene context.

### Infer the action behind change.
Cosmos 3 reads observed states and recovers the trajectory or control that explains how the scene changed, turning video evidence into actions.
